profile.headline: Work/Life Balance is Key to Happiness in your Career and Family

positions.title: Principal SaaS Integration Developer
positions.description:
Principal SaaS Integration Developer for Integrations, Migrations - LGGBU, Oracle USA.

Currently, I am the lead integration developer for integrations with Oracle Public Safety, utilizing iPaaS low-code and Javascript programming.

My position allows me to utilize past experience to help bridge the gap between Oracle SaaS Customers, Third-Party Vendors, Internal Design, Product, Security, and Development teams to help consult on the framework, configuration, and deployment of interfaces in Oracle's Local Government GBU.

I have had the privilege of working for various technology companies, amassing quite the niche knowledge base on all facets of software integrations. Collaboration with UX, Development, Product, Sales, Implementation, Support, Legal/Operations internally, bridged with coordination & communication with Customers and third-party vendors requires a diverse set of skills and knowledge. This is what I do - I have this knowledge, and I have experience in all these areas, and it's my role to ensure integrations are streamlined, efficient, effective, secure and easily repeatable.

Additionally, I create technical and high-level resource documentation, specification documents, etc., to ensure information access and dissemination is accurate, up-to-date, and easily accessed.

positions.title: GM, PM, Crestron Programmer, Audio Video Integrations, LLC
positions.description:
General and Project Manager for all commercial and residential projects.
Conference room teleconferencing systems, projector systems, whole home audio/video & automation and home theaters.

Work directly with the area's leading home builders, and commercial construction and development companies to provide the region's premier audio, video, automation and commercial system applications.

Manage day-to-day scheduling, service call, installation and project completion tasks for team of technicians and programmers.

Crestron programmer - Responsible for programming the entire range of systems for AVI clients. Small to large scale residential systems, as complete commercial business integration systems

Work directly with CEO / owner on design, materials handling/ordering, scheduling, client orientation, system installation, invoicing and new product development.

positions.title: Systems Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Manage team of Systems Engineers that design, spec, test, and deploy Interfaces for Zuercher's full suite of products.

Work closely with Sales and Support Teams to research, define scope and estimate new interface development, as well as help support issues for live customers.

Continuously work to refine process of designing, spec'ing, testing and deploying Interfaces, while introducing improved integration solutions for the Zuercher product line.

positions.title: Interface Analyst
positions.description:
First Interface Analyst at Zuercher. Responsible for working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering and Support to define our support and implementation process for Interfaces.

Main point of contact for customers and third-party vendors to procure technical details, define SoW, and responsible for the testing and delivery of successful Interfaces for all customers (old and new)

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.locationName: 623 S. Lyons Ave. Ste 300 Sioux Falls, SD 57016

Home Audio, Video & Automation company.

positions.title: Video Technician, Event Producer
positions.description: Freelance video screen technician. Responsible for setting up portable LED video screen displays, live event support, graphical content creation, camera operations, directing and event management/producer for several live events including: NBA All-Star Game, Concerts, Trade Shows, MTV Video Game Awards, NASCAR, Indy Car, and many more
